unit_cn: Unit 3 The World of Science 科学世界
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 3 词表(p122-123 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、科学/发明主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义给多个中文释义。专有名词(Gregorian/Goldbach/radium 等)跳过。

words.example_en: You only need to press a button to start the machine.
words.example_cn: 你只需按一个按钮就能启动机器。

words.example_en: The new laser can shoot a thin beam of light at the target.
words.example_cn: 这种新激光能向目标射出一束细光。

words.example_en: Gunpowder was one of the four great inventions of ancient China.
words.example_cn: 火药是中国古代四大发明之一。

words.example_en: Sailors used a compass to find their way far out at sea.
words.example_cn: 水手用指南针在远海中辨别方向。

words.example_en: Many games now create a virtual world that looks almost real.
words.example_cn: 如今许多游戏创造出几乎逼真的虚拟世界。

words.example_en: Virtual reality has been used to train new doctors safely.
words.example_cn: 虚拟现实已被用来安全地培训新医生。

words.example_en: Wearable tech such as smart watches has become very popular.
words.example_cn: 智能手表等可穿戴技术已变得非常流行。

words.example_en: The new battery is thin and flexible, so it can bend easily.
words.example_cn: 这种新电池又薄又柔韧,可以轻松弯曲。

words.example_en: A flexible battery can power a wearable device for days.
words.example_cn: 一块柔性电池可以为可穿戴设备供电数天。

words.example_en: In addition, important advances have been made in medicine.
words.example_cn: 除此之外,医学上也取得了重要进展。

words.example_en: Powerful computers can compute millions of numbers each second.
words.example_cn: 强大的计算机每秒能计算数百万个数字。

words.example_en: The walking house is capable of moving to a safer place by itself.
words.example_cn: 这座会走的房子能自行移动到更安全的地方。

words.example_en: Impressive stuff like this has been made by a big team.
words.example_cn: 这样令人惊叹的东西是由一个大团队制造的。

words.example_en: The desire to create new things drives every great inventor.
words.example_cn: 创造新事物的渴望驱动着每一位伟大的发明家。

words.example_en: In a passive sentence, the action is done to the subject.
words.example_cn: 在被动句中,动作是施加在主语身上的。

words.example_en: Our lives may be changed beyond recognition by new technology.
words.example_cn: 新技术可能把我们的生活改变得面目全非。

words.example_en: For instance, some restaurants have served 3D-printed food.
words.example_cn: 例如,有些餐馆已供应过3D打印的食物。

words.example_en: Significant advances have been made in solar technology.
words.example_cn: 太阳能技术取得了重大进步。

words.example_en: A turtle that had been injured in a fire was given a new shell.
words.example_cn: 一只在火灾中受伤的乌龟得到了一个新壳。

words.example_en: A chemist studies what different materials are made of.
words.example_cn: 化学家研究各种材料的构成。

words.example_en: An astronomer studies the stars, planets and other objects in space.
words.example_cn: 天文学家研究恒星、行星等太空中的天体。

words.example_en: A biologist studies living things such as plants and animals.
words.example_cn: 生物学家研究植物和动物等生物。

words.example_en: The old calendar was almost as accurate as the modern one.
words.example_cn: 这部古老的历法几乎和现代历法一样精确。

words.example_en: A minor planet was named after the great scientist.
words.example_cn: 一颗小行星以这位伟大科学家的名字命名。

words.example_en: Darwin's famous book explains the origin of different species.
words.example_cn: 达尔文的名著解释了不同物种的起源。

words.example_en: Many species change very slowly over a long time.
words.example_cn: 许多物种在漫长的时间里非常缓慢地变化。

words.example_en: The scientist studied more than a thousand rivers and streams.
words.example_cn: 这位科学家研究了一千多条河流和小溪。

words.example_en: Marie Curie did extraordinary work and won the Nobel Prize twice.
words.example_cn: 玛丽·居里做出了非凡的工作,两次获得诺贝尔奖。

words.example_en: She was regarded as a brilliant chemist by everyone in the lab.
words.example_cn: 实验室里的每个人都把她视为一位才华横溢的化学家。

words.example_en: A falling apple is said to have led Newton to his theory of gravity.
words.example_cn: 据说一个落下的苹果让牛顿想到了万有引力理论。

words.example_en: Alzheimer's is a common mental disease among older people.
words.example_cn: 阿尔茨海默病是老年人中常见的一种精神疾病。

words.example_en: At present there is still no cure for this disease.
words.example_cn: 目前这种疾病仍无治愈的方法。

words.example_en: Franklin helped to draft the Declaration of Independence.
words.example_cn: 富兰克林参与起草了《独立宣言》。

words.example_en: The Declaration of Independence has been read by millions of people.
words.example_cn: 《独立宣言》已被数百万人阅读。

words.example_en: Franklin's experiment with lightning made him famous.
words.example_cn: 富兰克林的闪电实验使他声名远扬。

words.example_en: A flash of lightning hit the kite during the storm.
words.example_cn: 一道闪电在暴风雨中击中了风筝。

words.example_en: New research suggests the story may be fiction rather than fact.
words.example_cn: 新研究表明这个故事也许是虚构而非事实。

words.example_en: A metal key was attached to the wet string of the kite.
words.example_cn: 一把金属钥匙被系在风筝湿润的线上。

words.example_en: A key was attached to the string so the electricity could pass down.
words.example_cn: 钥匙被系在线上,这样电流就能传下来。

words.example_en: A bright flash of light suddenly appeared in the dark sky.
words.example_cn: 一道亮光突然出现在黑暗的天空中。

words.example_en: The wet string can conduct electricity from the sky to the key.
words.example_cn: 湿绳能把电从天空传导到钥匙上。

words.example_en: Scientific experiments help us to find out the truth.
words.example_cn: 科学实验帮助我们查明真相。

words.example_en: Scientists found that the old story was not entirely true.
words.example_cn: 科学家发现那个旧故事并不完全属实。

words.example_en: Gravity is the force that pulls a falling apple to the ground.
words.example_cn: 引力是把落下的苹果拉向地面的力。

words.example_en: More than one account of the experiment has been written.
words.example_cn: 关于这个实验已有不止一种记述。

words.example_en: There is no proof that the apple hit Newton on the head.
words.example_cn: 没有证据表明苹果砸到了牛顿的头上。

words.example_en: Follow each step of the procedure carefully during the experiment.
words.example_cn: 做实验时请仔细遵循每一个步骤。

words.example_en: Darwin explained how species change through natural selection.
words.example_cn: 达尔文解释了物种如何通过自然选择而演变。
